expA.name: Experiment A: Goal without Instructions
expA.directive: My desktop is cluttered with scattered notes and text documents. Help me organize them.
expA.finding: Returned conversational response or clarification request without executing autonomous multi-step organization loop.

expB.name: Experiment B: Frontend Disconnection during Mission
expB.finding: Node.js background thread continued execution independently of frontend client. Completed 3/3 steps.

expC.name: Experiment C: Backend Restart Recovery
expC.finding: Interrupted RUNNING mission was safely identified, running steps reset to PENDING, and mission status set to PAUSED to prevent corrupt execution on restart. However, it does NOT resume autonomously; it requires human operator interaction to resume.

expD.name: Experiment D: Scheduled Task Execution without Chat
expD.notificationDetails: You currently have 25 pending task(s) registered in memory.
expD.finding: SchedulerService detected overdue job during background 5000ms tick, executed DAILY_TASK_SUMMARY, recorded notification "You currently have 25 pending task(s) registered in memory.", and marked job COMPLETED with zero frontend or chat interaction.

expE.name: Experiment E: Obstacle & Adaptive Replanning
expE.finding: Mission failed with null: null. Dynamic LLM-driven replanning did not synthesize a new plan.

expF.name: Experiment F: Environmental Change Detection
expF.mutationType: External filesystem file creation in application directory
expF.finding: JARVIS has no active filesystem watcher (chokidar/fs.watch) or Windows OS event hook (SetWinEventHook). Environmental state is ONLY inspected when an explicit tool call is executed. Unprompted changes in the desktop or disk remain completely undetected.

expG.name: Experiment G: Multi-Application Independent Coordination
expG.finding: JARVIS successfully coordinated launches of Notepad and Calculator via Python desktop automation agent, followed by real-time hardware telemetry retrieval (368ms).
